{{Quote|You see, Captain, there's an Elom ''[sic]'' commanding that force&hellip;and Elomin simply cannot handle the unstructured attack profile of a properly executed Marg Sabl.|Grand Admiral Thrawn, to Captain Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="HTTE" />}}
An '''Elomin''' commanded a [[Elomin task force|task force]] of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that served the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] and his [[Task force/Legends|task force]] were present in the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa-skai system]] as part of the New Republic [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] efforts to entice the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] to join the Republic. During the deployment, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] attempted an information raid on the planet's [[Celebratus Archive|extensive library facilities]]. The Elomin commander ordered his task force to engage and pursue, chasing the Imperial intruders into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. After reverting to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], the Elomin commander found himself confronted with an [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. Although the task force had the advantage of numbers, the New Republic unit was [[Destruction of the Elomin task force|destroyed]] when the commander of the ''Chimaera'', [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], employed a [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] closure maneuver against the force. The Elomin commander, unable to properly counter the unstructured attack profile of the tactic due to his logical mind, was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the engagement.

==Biography==
[[File:IsThisANebulon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Elomin task force]]
This [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] was a [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Military]] officer who commanded a [[Elomin task force|task force]] comprising four [[Assault Frigate Mark I]]s supported by several [[Fighter wing/Legends|wings]] of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]]<ref name="HTTE" /> and manned exclusively by his fellow Elomin. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Task force/Legends|task force]] was on patrol in the [[Obroa-skai system/Legends|Obroa-skai system]]<ref name="HTTESB">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> as part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] efforts to bring the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] into the Republic. While in-[[Star system/Legends|system]], a small force of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] decanted from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and began an information raid against Obroa-skai's [[Celebratus Archive|massive library]]. The Elomin commander directed his task force to intercept, and the Imperial scout ships began to flee back into hyperspace. The Elomin ordered his ships to pursue and, before the task force entered hyperspace, a communication was sent back to their New Republic superiors informing them of the formation's actions.<ref name="HTTE" />

Upon reversion to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]], the Elomin commander ordered his task force to deploy in a [[symmetric cloud-vee formation]] as they chased the scout ships toward their mother ship, the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]. The Republic force was more than sufficient to deal with one lone [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], so the Elomin commander elected to engage the Imperial force. As the task force moved in, the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] sentry line engaged the vanguard of the New Republic task force while the scout ships made for the safety of the Star Destroyer; the sentry line took a single casualty before falling back. As the New Republic task force closed on the ''Chimaera'', the Star Destroyer's Sector Four sentry line scrambled out of the way, then reformed behind the Elomin task force and began [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] all transmissions.<ref name="HTTE" />

[[File:ElominTaskForceWreckage-HttE1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The wreckage of the task force]]
The commander of the ''Chimaera'', the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], had deduced that there was an Elomin commanding the task force judging by the way that the opposing New Republic commander had engaged the initial sentry line during the opening moments of the engagement. With that in mind, Thrawn tailored a counter to the opposing commander's attack. Knowing that the Elomin mind was logical and incapable of reacting to unstructured and undisciplined attack profiles, Thrawn deployed his starfighter [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] in a simple [[Marg Sabl/Legends|Marg Sabl]] closure maneuver to break up the incoming attack. The Elomin commander, psychologically unable to deal with the tactic, attempted to counter it, but to no avail. The ''Chimaera'' entered the battle, and within an hour the commander was [[Death/Legends|dead]], and his task force completely destroyed.<ref name="HTTE" />

==Personality and traits==
As an Elomin, the task force commander possessed a very logical and ordered mind. As such, the commander was incapable of formulating a tactical response to the Marg Sabl maneuver, which employed an unstructured attack profile.<ref name="HTTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Elomin task force commander was mentioned the [[1991]] release ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first novel in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']].<ref name="HTTE" />
